measurement_protocol_next.reference_selection: Freeze source-only pitch/string/articulation/segment annotations and all quality exclusions before candidate access; hold out whole player/guitar clusters and phrases. Same recording repetitions test repeatability, not hardware generalization.
tone: Tracked H1/H2/H3 and upper partial ratios at attack/body/held windows
ERB-band shape, upper-band decay slope/curvature and noise floor
Modal decay fit quality/censoring, inharmonicity, beating and attack-pitch relaxation
behaviour: Same-note repick continuity, onset-to-peak and transient windows across stroke directions
Same-string semitone/large changes, intentional slide/hammer pitch and energy continuity
Rapid Palm/open/Dead changes, release/choke tails and bend/vibrato behaviour
measurement_protocol_next.render_controls: Unchanged shipping A versus isolated candidate B with same production events, seed, controls, rate and block; one constant alignment and whole-crop RMS gain, shared peak headroom, no EQ/timewarp/per-hit gain or candidate-dependent mask. Separate dry and identically calibrated common-reamp evaluation.
measurement_protocol_next.95_percent: Do not derive a scalar from unrelated feature improvements. One possible future registered operational target is95% held-out feature-cell coverage within real-repeat prediction regions, with cluster-aware uncertainty and no averaging away critical domain failures. That would measure coverage under its explicit protocol; it would not equal95% subjective similarity.
measurement_protocol_next.listening: Existing blind contract remains unrun without qualified listeners and lawful held-out audio. Extend to premium exact-eight cross-genre source discrimination/naturalness and licensed same-score competitors before broad authenticity or market claims.
